root_cause_label: Heuristic Fixed-Size Batching Without Cost-Model-Driven DP Optimization
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent committed to a naive heuristic approach (KMeans shape selection plus fixed-size batch splitting sorted by gen_len) from step 4 onward and never attempted the DP-based G_max-aware segmentation required to meet performance thresholds, while also spending 12 steps (6-17) unable to get cost model output due to stdout swallowing that further delayed feedback.
t_err_evidence: create a file named better_packer.py ... implement a more advanced batching strategy ... batches of similar gen_len
t_commit_evidence: Step 4: Once better_packer.py was created with the heuristic batching paradigm, all subsequent steps were incremental tweaks (batch size changes 64/128/256/512, switch to KMeans shape selection, gen_len sorting) within the same fundamentally wrong framework. No step after 4 shows any consideration of DP-based G_max segmentation, making the failing outcome locked in from this point.
trigger_explanation: The agent lacks the domain knowledge that the correct optimization strategy for this task requires dynamic programming segmentation within each shape bucket to explicitly minimize G_max per segment, which is the dominant cost driver. Instead it defaults to the heuristic of sorting by gen_len and using fixed batch sizes, which cannot achieve the performance thresholds regardless of parameter tuning.
